summary: The branch implements plan.md as written: exact field names and defaults, no antiparallel Slerp on the reverse path, dt-free mouse look with the stick path still scaled by delta time, a self-right unreachable airborne or mid-drift, both duration fields correct on all three exit paths, and five CSV columns appended to a 20-column header whose first 15 match origin/main byte for byte. All hard constraints hold and I re-ran compile_check (Compiles clean., 0/0 both passes), pytest (34 passed) and playtest_row --list myself, reproducing the recorded evidence.
